title: Magician's Legendary Items
body:
# Magician's Legendary Items
This datapack adds 6 legendary items each with there own set of custom abilities and unique textures. These can be used for all purposes but are mainly intended for PvP/SMPs and may not be well balanced for PvE.

**IMPORTANT**

**This datapack requires [this](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/magicians-legendary-items-rp) resource pack to work correctly, make sure they are both installed!**


## Obtaining
These legendaries are NOT obtainable in survival. They must be obtained with commands.
- Tidal Blade: `/function legendaries:tidal_blade/give`
- Frenzy: `/function legendaries:frenzy/give`
- Ancient Helm: `/function legendaries:ancient_helm/give`
- Ender Cloak: `/function legendaries:ender_cloak/give`
- Earthen Belt: `/function legendaries:earthen_belt/give`
- Speed Boots: `/function legendaries:speed_boots/give`
- All Legendaries: `/function legendaries:give_all`

## Extra
If you are using this datapack for an SMP keep in mind it is balenced around these gear limits:
- Full max diamond gear
- Level 1 strength potions
- Level 1 speed potions
- No Ender Pearls
